name: mark_resolved
description: mark_resolved: Record that a call was resolved without creating a ticket. Used when troubleshooting, an account unlock, or a password reset resolved the caller's issue directly. Writes an interaction record so the call has a concrete state change even when no ticket was created.

flow_id.description: The type of issue that was resolved.

resolution_type.description: How the issue was resolved. resolved_via_troubleshooting covers all cases where the issue was fixed during the call (including successful unlocks and password resets).
